lines.head: ## Corrigendum to b731’s record (relay data/b731_events.txt rows (1)-(10) and data/b731_defects.txt): ten events and nineteen defects, each CLAIM or CLOSE and NEW or REPEAT; the author’s repair at its head, the act module rendered and the dropped name failing the pre-lock dry; the re-price computed from the banks, the Lean paths and the declarations beside them read against the tree, the N3 reader keyed to the landed lines, at tools/standing/ v1.12.0, each controlled on b731’s banks, under (R342)(1)-(2)
